BACKEND AND DATA
Backend modules share a common data layer
HRMS Platform  |  Repository analysis  |  UI examples are repository screenshots
Java 21 target · Spring Boot 3.2.3
Controllers validate requests and define REST routes.
Services coordinate business operations across modules.
Repositories and JPA entities persist domain records.
Flyway scripts V1–V15 evolve the relational schema.
Tenant-aware relational model
Core records include users, employees, departments, attendance, leave, payroll, notifications, audit history, and tenant configuration.
Domain tables extend into workflow approvals, documents, expenses, interviews, shifts, assets, offboarding, and workforce intelligence.
Review item: V1 contains MySQL-style index/column alteration syntax while the current runtime configuration targets PostgreSQL.

Repository evidence: backend/pom.xml; backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__fix_payroll_columns.sql through V15; entity @Table mappings
The full entity inventory and migration map are in DATABASE_DESIGN.md.

ATTENDANCE AND LEAVE
Attendance and leave are connected to approval paths
HRMS Platform  |  Repository analysis  |  UI examples are repository screenshots
Attendance
Punches, breaks, biometric/CSV ingestion, geofence checks, regularization, office locations, and configurable policies.
Leave
Applications, policy configuration, balance ledgers, accrual scheduling, review, cancellation, and employee notifications.

Repository evidence: modules/attendance/AttendanceController.java; AttendanceService.java; PolicyController.java; modules/leave/LeaveController.java; LeavePolicyController.java; docs/screenshots/04_biometric_attendance.png and 07_leave_management.png

IMPLEMENTATION REVIEW
Production readiness needs a few focused confirmations
HRMS Platform  |  Repository analysis  |  UI examples are repository screenshots
Database
V1 SQL syntax appears MySQL-oriented; reconcile with PostgreSQL migration history.
Session security
logout-all has no visible revocation logic; refresh cookie uses secure(false).
Tenant boundaries
Confirm tenant and record ownership checks on ID-based self-service endpoints.
Business rules
Validate payroll, offboarding and expense-to-payroll behavior with domain owners.
External services
Confirm live interview/media setup, file persistence, and Redis fallback behavior.
Evidence is drawn from the checked-out source tree. Treat these items as review questions, not confirmed production incidents.
